def _child_first(count, parent):
        children = [[] for _ in range(count)]
        roots = []
        for node, par in enumerate(parent):
            if par < 0:
                roots.append(node)
            else:
                children[par].append(node)
        order = []
        stack = roots[:]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            order.append(node)
            stack.extend(children[node])
        order.reverse()
        return order

    def tnode(self, i):
        return self.tbase + i - 1

    def topo(self):
        order = [self.R]
        for s in range(self.S):
            order.append(self.a[s])
            order.append(self.b[s])
            order.append(self.e[s])
        order.extend(self.tnode(i) for i in range(2 * self.n0 - 1, 0, -1))
        order.extend(self.w)
        order.extend(self.z)
        order.extend(self.h[g] for g in self.group_order)
        order.append(self.Z)
        return order

    def wants(self, level):
        return [ceil_frac(level * t) for t in self.target]

    # ---------------- network construction ----------------
    def build(self, kind, want=None):
        weighted = kind == 'opt'
        extra = 2 if kind != 'opt' else 0
        g = Graph(self.NC + extra, weighted)
        meta = {'g': g}
        inf = self.inf_cap
        tok = []
        for s in range(self.S):
            row = [g.add(self.R, self.a[s], self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s]),
                   g.add(self.a[s], self.b[s], self.B)]
            row.append(g.add(self.b[s], self.a[s + 1], self.B)
                       if s + 1 < self.S else -1)
            row.append(g.add(self.b[s], self.e[s], self.caps[s]))
            row.append(g.add(self.e[s], self.tnode(self.n0 + s), inf,
                             self.times[s] if weighted else 0))
            tok.append(row)
        meta['tok'] = tok
        for i in range(2 * self.n0 - 1, 1, -1):
            g.add(self.tnode(i), self.tnode(i >> 1), inf)
        tree_out = [[] for _ in range(self.tree_n + 1)]
        win_in = []
        win_out = []
        for j in range(self.J):
            cost = (-(self.windows[j][1] + self.W * self.value[j])
                    if weighted else 0)
            arcs = []
            for c in self.covers[j]:
                arc = g.add(self.tnode(c), self.w[j], inf, cost)
                arcs.append(arc)
                tree_out[c].append((arc, j))
            win_in.append(arcs)
            win_out.append(g.add(self.w[j], self.z[self.windows[j][0]], 1))
        meta['tree_out'] = tree_out
        meta['win_in'] = win_in
        meta['win_out'] = win_out
        meta['grp'] = [g.add(self.h[i], self.group_head[i], self.groups[i][1])
                       for i in range(self.G)]
        if kind == 'opt':
            meta['bonus'] = [g.add(self.z[f], self.flow_head[f], want[f], -self.M)
                             if want[f] > 0 else -1 for f in range(self.F)]
            meta['normal'] = [g.add(self.z[f], self.flow_head[f],
                                    self.ceiling[f] - want[f])
                              for f in range(self.F)]
        else:
            ss = self.NC
            tt = self.NC + 1
            meta['ss'] = ss
            meta['tt'] = tt
            if kind == 'inc':
                meta['z'] = [g.add(self.z[f], self.flow_head[f], self.ceiling[f])
                             for f in range(self.F)]
                meta['zr'] = g.add(self.Z, self.R, self.J)
                meta['ssa'] = [g.add(ss, self.flow_head[f], 0)
                               for f in range(self.F)]
                meta['tta'] = [g.add(self.z[f], tt, 0) for f in range(self.F)]
            else:
                meta['z'] = [g.add(self.z[f], self.flow_head[f],
                                   self.ceiling[f] - want[f])
                             for f in range(self.F)]
                meta['zr'] = g.add(self.Z, self.R, self.J)
                meta['ssa'] = [g.add(ss, self.flow_head[f], want[f])
                               for f in range(self.F)]
                meta['tta'] = [g.add(self.z[f], tt, want[f])
                               for f in range(self.F)]
        return meta

    # ---------------- flow projection ----------------
    def decompose(self, meta):
        """Project tree flows onto a window -> slot assignment."""
        g = meta['g']
        n0 = self.n0
        tok = meta['tok']
        tree_out = meta['tree_out']
        assignment = [-1] * self.J
        up = {}
        for i in range(2 * n0 - 1, 0, -1):
            if i >= n0:
                s = i - n0
                pool = [s] * g.cap[tok[s][4] ^ 1] if s < self.S else []
            else:
                pool = up.pop(2 * i, None)
                extra = up.pop(2 * i + 1, None)
                if pool is None:
                    pool = extra if extra is not None else []
